info.name: AISafe - Flight Routes (distributed)
info.description:
Tests of the Flight Routes component with 3 replicas (SIDIS Assignments 1 and 2).

Assignment 2 (CQRS + RabbitMQ): every GET is answered from the LOCAL read model of the replica, which holds the routes and flights of all replicas (built from events), so no GET depends on the peers and X-Partial-Response is no longer used by these read paths. Commands (POST, PATCH) run on the replica that owns the entity; a PATCH sent to another replica is forwarded to the owner.

Prerequisite: RabbitMQ (infra/.env + Docker, see docs/README.md), then from code/: `./scripts/start-all.sh 3 demo` (or `.\scripts\start-all.ps1 -Profiles demo`). Folders 0-6 only need the 3 Flight Routes replicas (`./scripts/start-replicas.sh flightroutes demo`) plus the broker; folders 7, 9 and 10 also need Aircraft Management (am1) and Airports (ap1).
The databases are files (code/data/), so data survives restarts: counts are checked as "at least" or on the demo routes only, and folders 7-9 create their own data with random identifiers so the collection can be run again. Delete code/data/ to start from the demo data only.

Use the environment FlightRoutes.postman_environment.json and run the folders IN ORDER with the Collection Runner or newman (the polling requests of folder 9 repeat themselves with setNextRequest, which a single "Send" does not do). Folder 0 creates the tokens.
MANUAL steps: before folder 6 STOP replica 2 (port 8184); before folder 10 STOP replicas 2 and 3 (ports 8184 and 8284) and keep replica 1 running.

8. Concurrency (run after folder 7)
item.description:
FlightRoute has optimistic locking (@Version) and a write conflict is answered with 409, but the version is NOT part of the API: GET does not return it and PATCH does not accept it (no ETag/If-Match). A client therefore cannot be told that it is updating stale data: sequential updates are last-writer-wins. A 409 only happens when two PATCHes overlap inside the owner replica.
This folder (1) shows the last-writer-wins behaviour, (2) sends 6 PATCHes in parallel through the 3 replicas from a test script and checks that every answer is 200 or 409 and that the final state is one of the values written.
More load: run sub-folder 8.1 many times from two runners at the same time, e.g. two Postman Collection Runner windows with 50 iterations each, or two terminals with
`npx newman run FlightRoutes.postman_collection.json -e <env exported after folders 0, 7 and 8> --folder "8.1 Concurrent update (run with iterations)" -n 50`
(export the environment with `--export-environment` so both runs use the same ccRouteId and token). Every answer must be 200 or 409.

item.name: 9. Assignment 2 — events, read models and eventual consistency
item.description:
Write -> event -> projection on every replica. Needs RabbitMQ, the 3 Flight Routes replicas, Aircraft Management (am1) and Airports (ap1); folder 0 for the tokens. Creates its own airports, aircraft model and aircraft with random identifiers, so it can be run again.
- The replica that executes a command (the owner) answers it from its read model at once (read-your-writes).
- The other replicas get it through RabbitMQ: the "Poll" requests repeat themselves every 500 ms, for at most ~10 s, until the replica has converged (eventual consistency). The test name shows how many retries were needed.
Run with the Collection Runner or newman (`npx newman run FlightRoutes.postman_collection.json -e FlightRoutes.postman_environment.json --folder "9. Assignment 2 — events, read models and eventual consistency"`, after folder 0).

10. Assignment 2 — reads with the other replicas stopped (MANUAL: stop fr2 and fr3 first)
item.description:
MANUAL: run folder 9 first, then STOP replicas 2 and 3 (ports 8184 and 8284) and keep replica 1 running.
Replica 1 answers every read from its own read model, including routes and flights owned by the stopped replicas: no peer call, no X-Partial-Response. Writes owned by a stopped replica fail with 503 until it is back; when it restarts, its durable queue delivers the events it missed.
